label: PLACEHOLDER, NOT A DECISION
description: Within each axis every redundancy-group-dampened unit gets the same weight (a group of n members shares one unit, each member 1/n of it; a variable with no group is its own unit). Weights are recomputed from the ACTIVE grouping and from each company's applicable variables, and always sum to 1 per axis. This is a stand-in so the engine can run; the real weights are being deliberated separately. Drop an additional file in this folder (mode 'explicit', see weights.py) to add another set without any code change.
